# Telegram Reader

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Telegram channels are unedited, anonymous-friendly feeds where pump calls, copied headlines and confident nonsense travel at the same speed as real news: treat every signal claim as unverified, and acting on channel tips carries a real risk of loss. No output here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: a read-only reader for Telegram built on tdl, the Telegram CLI, aimed at financial news and market research. It lists your chats and channels with filters (channels only, or a name search for that one news channel you half remember), and exports messages from a channel or group as structured JSON: the last N messages, a time range, an ID range, or a single topic thread, always with text content included rather than media only. Presentation leads with the most relevant updates, each with its timestamp and source channel, groups messages from several channels by theme (macro, earnings, crypto), and calls out breaking news, price targets and earnings surprises as claims to verify, not facts to repeat. It can also run several accounts through tdl namespaces when you keep work and personal Telegram apart. From the himself65/finance-skills repository (MIT). Honest caveats: this reader is honest about reading a third-party platform through your own account and tools: tdl logs in as you, interactively, by QR code, phone code or an existing official Telegram Desktop session, and you...
